CLM-EDA-0001.statement: SLED-IFV achieves approximately 603x solver-only speedup on the otbn_sec_add benchmark compared to the baseline.

extra_quotes: Using the same ABC-PDR backend [ 12], SLED-IFV achieves up to 603× solver-only speedup and converts two 12-hour PDR timeouts into completed proofs.
Verification uses UC Berkeley ABC 1.01 [4]: proof obligations run with pdr, while bounded probes and faithfulness controls use bmc3.
Claude Opus 4.7 (claude-opus-4-7), invoked through Claude Code CLI 2.1.141, serves as both the proposer and artifact generator.
Because𝑀 # is an over-approximation, an Ob2 counterexample need not correspond to a concrete leak.
An incorrect proposal or artifact may waste solver time, but it cannot certify an incorrect result.
